_comment: Update log. Outages are written automatically by .github/scripts/monitor.js when an Overwatch build change locks the loader, and closed again once the status returns to UNDETECTED. Uptime on the status page is calculated from this. Entries where start == end are silent updates - shipped without taking the loader down - and contribute no downtime.

downtime.reason: Config auto-swap issues fixed - silent update, current loader unaffected
